parts.script:
A: Hey Sam, have you thought about what we should do this weekend? 
B: I was thinking we could go to the beach! It’s supposed to be sunny all weekend. 
A: That sounds perfect! I haven’t been to the beach in ages. 
B: Right? We could take a picnic and maybe play some beach volleyball. 
A: Great idea! Do you think we need to book a spot or just show up? 
B: I think it's best to book. Last time, it was really crowded because of a festival. 
A: Good call. I can check online for some options. 
B: Also, should we invite Tom? He loves the beach too. 
A: Yes, definitely! I’ll message him and see if he’s free. 
B: Awesome! Let’s make it a fun day out. 
A: I can bring snacks and drinks! What else should we take? 
B: Don’t forget sunscreen! We don’t want to end up sunburned. 
A: True, I’ll add that to the list. It’s going to be a fantastic weekend! 
B: Can’t wait!

questions.question: What activity do A and B decide to plan for the weekend?
questions.explanation: A and B decide to go to the beach.

questions.question: Complete the form. Write no more than TWO WORDS.
questions.explanation: The activity planned is a beach trip, and they mention bringing sunscreen.

questions.question: Who do A and B consider inviting?
questions.explanation: They mention inviting Tom, who loves the beach.
